visualCharacteristics: Horizontal media-object speaker items: square headshot (about 100px) on the left, then bold name, small role and company line, and a row of monochrome LinkedIn, GitHub and X icons. Compact density, no card border, items stack vertically.
contentPattern: One row per presenter, two cells: 1) headshot image (alt = speaker name), 2) text: heading with the name, paragraph with role and company, paragraph with social links (LinkedIn, GitHub, X). The number of rows varies per page.
usage: Presenters or speakers list on webinar and event detail pages, usually beside a 'Presenters' heading in a 'split' section.
reuseGuidance: Use for any list of people with a headshot, name, role and social links. Social links are recognised by host (linkedin.com, github.com, twitter.com or x.com) and shown as icons; other links stay as text links.
